title: WP-UAT-E: operator admission of badf-uat (SHADOWED -> ACTIVE) with #289 and #293 recorded open
objective: Record the operator's admission of badf-uat on WP-UAT-D's evidence, flip the registry status, and make the non-grant (UAT-I14/I15) a mechanical property of the admitted state.
business_value: A capability admitted without its open control defects on the record invites a later reader to mistake ACTIVE for a clean control path. This rung admits and records together, so the admission cannot be cited as evidence the controls are sound.
in_scope: badf/skill-registry.json: badf-uat SHADOWED -> ACTIVE, digest unchanged
tests/test_badf_uat_contract.py: the one exact pin moves with the ladder, plus a new test asserting ACTIVE grants no acceptance authority
out_of_scope: Any control behaviour change -- this rung flips a status and records; it fixes nothing
#289's substring fix (approved plan, separate WP, ids already claimed)
acceptance_criteria: Registry reads ACTIVE and the digest is byte-identical to the pre-flip value, asserted
The exact status pin asserts ACTIVE and moves in the SAME change as the registry

UAT-I14/I15 non-grant asserted as a property of the ADMITTED state -- allowed_tools empty, the recommendation enum unable to express an acceptance, Layer-2 pinned to principal_type human -- verified red-first by widening the enum and by granting a tool
The ladder and the control-plane section both name #289 and #293 as open against the admitted controls

test_obligations.claim: ACTIVE grants no acceptance authority; the three facts hold together at the admitted status

note: Lean ADVISORY. Status flip and records only; no control behaviour changes.
